name: Admin Accounting Cuentas de Cobro Center
description: Superuser manages all cuentas de cobro at /panel/accounting/collections (tab renamed from Cobros): status counters (emitidas/pagadas/vencidas/anuladas with totals), segmented status filter, table with numero/origen (hosting/proyecto/ingreso/otro)/cliente/total/emision/vence/estado (Vencida tint via is_overdue) and row actions: view linked income, download PDF, resend to client, mark paid (expected-linked accounts route through the Liquidar modal instead of a plain confirm), cancel (cancelling a hosting-linked account resumes its expiry notices; cancelling frees the linked income for a new cuenta). Since Aug 2026 Cliente and Proyecto are separate sortable, filterable columns and the row opens admin-accounting-collection-detail. Since Aug 2026 a cuenta issued with a zero-day payment term carries no due date at all: the Vence column stays empty and the row can never read as Vencida nor fall into that tab, because is_overdue derives from a date that no longer exists. Since Aug 2026 the row also offers eliminar, which is not anular: it removes the record physically and only appears when the backend says can_delete — the cuenta is already anulada, or it never reached the client (borrador, or emitida whose email failed). A pagada can be neither anulada nor eliminada. The confirmation names consecutivo, cliente and monto and demands the word ELIMINAR, because the delete is irreversible; the consecutivo is not reused (the series keeps a hole) and the linked income goes back to being billable. Every deletion leaves a DELETED row in the accounting historial naming the consecutivo that is gone.
